messages:
Nora: Kicking off RFC follow-up for long-term refactor: peel enrichment and feature-gating logic out of user-service into a new feature-surface service. Goal: reduce hotpath churn and make incremental paydown of tech debt.

Eli: +1. Two immediate concerns: 1) API surface and 2) cache ownership. We should define a tiny stable API and avoid chatty round-trips.

Sasha: Suggest API: evalFeature(tenant, user_ctx) -> features + version id. Keep response compact. Add a binding contract and a compatibility layer in user-service to avoid simultaneous deploys.

Nora: Migration plan sketch:
- define API + schema + README
- implement shim in user-service that calls feature-surface behind flag `feature.features_v2`
- shadow for 10d, run comparator diffs daily (fuzzy tolerant for optional fields)
- dual-read cache period 14d with background reconciliation
- canary 5% then 25% with perf guardrails

Eli: For cache, local LRU with soft TTL 200ms; authoritative store stays in feature-surface. Add telemetry: cache_hit, fetch_latency_ms, stale_count.

Sasha: Observability: preserve trace-id across calls, add a comparator metric fraction_mismatch_on_shadow, and set alert at 0.5% for 1h. Also sample full request payloads for diffs (scrubbed PII).

Ravi: Add cost checkpoint: simulate fanout at 2x expected peak before >10% rollout. Also ensure circuit-breaker defaults to fallback to legacy user-service behavior.

CI-bot: created job: feature-surface/contract-runner (non-blocking)

Nora: Ownership: Eli will prototype contract-runner; Sasha owns dashboards/alerts; Ravi owns rollout checklist + cost sim. I'll own API docs and shim.

Eli: I'll build a small replay runner that pulls sampled traffic, calls both paths, and emits a diff report. Will post PR early next week.

Sasha: I'll add dashboard templates to the observability repo and wire the comparator metric into alerting.

Nora: Add rollback triggers: if p95 latency on hotpath increases >7% or mismatch >1% stop and revert flag. Also require PM signoff after successful 25% run.

Ravi: Noted. Let's reconvene in one week to review PRs and the initial contract-runner results.

Nora: Thanks all — I'll open GH issues and link here.
